newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy bond futures soft but attempt late comeback.
newsitem.headline: Italy bond futures soft but attempt late comeback.

text.p: 1515 GMT - Italian bond futures make valiant comeback from lows but still down on day. Dealers say market needs to pause as awaits EMU related news from Italy and Germany. Unnerved by shortfall in German tax revenues and waiting to see Italian spending reform proposals in document of three-year economic goals due by month end. Continued uncertainty about chances of U.S. rate hike next week also keeping brows furrowed. * Bonds:Feb07 -12bps at 97.45, yield 7.23 pct, spread vs 10-yr Bund 153 bps. *Futures:Jun LIF -18 bps at 130.21, sup 130.00, res 130.50. *Lira:986.65/6.95 per mark soft on Wednesday levels.
